name: BridgeManagement
comment:workspaces: P2 build-cost: the 10 html5 UI apps are npm workspaces so `npm ci` installs their shared @ui5/cli toolchain ONCE (hoisted) instead of per-module. The MTA html5 builders therefore only run `npm run build` (no per-module npm ci). Excludes app/router (separate approuter module).
comment:xlsx: SECURITY (D18 supply-chain): xlsx is pinned to SheetJS's patched 0.20.3 from their official CDN (cdn.sheetjs.com), NOT the npm registry. The npm-published xlsx is frozen at 0.18.5 with a HIGH advisory — prototype pollution (GHSA-4r6h-8v6p-xvw6) + ReDoS (GHSA-5pgg-2g8v-p4x9) — and no fix on npm. 0.20.3 is the vendor's official mitigation (above the 0.19.3 / 0.20.2 patch lines). The build/CI env must be able to reach cdn.sheetjs.com on `npm ci`.

scripts.lint:ui5: for d in admin-bridges restrictions prioritisation-report dashboard bms-admin prioritisation map-view mass-edit mass-upload bhi-explorer; do echo "--- $d ---"; (cd app/$d && npx --yes ui5lint) || true; done
scripts.test:opa: cd app/admin-bridges && npx --yes karma start webapp/test/karma.conf.js --single-run
